ranked_hypotheses.title: Source-Parameter-Imaging (iSPI) Dip-Projected Potential-Field Contact Dipole & Sibson Hydrothermal Fault-Valve Breaching with Paleoshoreline/Road Decontamination
layers: training_features.tif (Bands 1-19, especially B2 rtp, B3 tmi_hg, B9 tmi_vg, B11 iso_grav_anom_vg, B13 iso_grav_anom, B15 depth_to_base_surf, B17 cond_surf, B18 iso_grav_anom_hg)
external/paleo_geothermal_regional.zip (Paleo sinter, travertine, tufa, silicified fault seals)
external/gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv (temp_c, geothermquartz_c, geothermchalc_c, geothermcat_c; dist_known_fault_px STRICTLY EXCLUDED)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Thurston & Brown (1994) local-wavenumber structural contact ridge kappa_SPI = |grad(atan2(VG, HG))| computed for both shallow magnetics (B9/B3 + TMI-TMI_up150) and deep isostatic gravity (B11/B18), coupled by Andersonian 60-deg normal-fault up-dip pullback (cot 60 = 0.58 * B15 along -grad B15), intersected with Sibson fault-valve hydrothermal alteration (high-pass RTP magnetite-destruction trough x K/Th adularia enrichment x MT smectite clay-cap B17 x 2m temperature probe F2mDAB & paleo-sinter seals), and decontaminated against constant-elevation Lake Lahontan (1332m) / Bonneville (1463/1552m) wave-cut strandlines and TIGER road/rail embankments.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: ~75% of Great Basin geothermal systems are blind (Faulds et al., 2016): opaline/chalcedonic self-sealing and rapid piedmont/playa sedimentation erase discrete Holocene scarps, causing single-dataset photo/DEM mappers to omit active blind conduits.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_fleet: First GEMSDOE lane to compute dual Magnetic-Gravity Source Parameter Imaging (iSPI) local-wavenumber contact ridges from exact VG/HG pairs (B9/B3 and B11/B18) with cot(60)-scaled basement-thickness dip pullback coupled to Sibson fault-valve magnetite-destruction + F2mDAB + paleo-sinter + paleoshoreline/road decontamination.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: +0.025 to +0.045 HOLDOUT-DTI over heuristic multi-physics baseline

ranked_hypotheses.title: Asymmetric Mode-II/III Wing-Crack Dilational Lobes (±22 deg), Step-Over Relay Bridges & Counterfactual Component-Withheld 3-Family SAR-PU Ensemble
layers: existing_faults.tif (strictly visible mask per holdout fold; counterfactual sub-withheld components during training)
training_features.tif Bands 4, 7, 8 (geodetic strain invariant, shear rate, dilatation rate)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Propagating normal/transtensional fault tips concentrate Coulomb tensile/shear stress not only dead-ahead (0 deg) but strongly in asymmetric ±22-deg horsetail wing-crack splays (400m-2.8km), bidirectional en-echelon relay ramps, and 600m-1.8km across-strike antithetic graben twins. A heterogeneous 3-family OOF stack (LightGBM + HistGradientBoosting + Calibrated Ridge-MLP) trained on counterfactual component-withheld positives (>3.0 px off visible catalogue) with dual LiDAR-seam x quadrant Bayes prior calibration predicts off-catalogue fault probability without starving the 24.6% non-LiDAR footprint.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: Mappers trace the main high-throw master fault segment (~10+ m scarp) and arrest the line where throw drops below ~1 m into distributed horsetail wing-cracks, step-over relay ramps, or antithetic piedmont splays.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_fleet: Replaces symmetric collinear-only rays and single-family GBDTs with explicit ±22-deg oblique wing-crack FFT kernels + counterfactual component-withheld 3-family heterogeneous OOF stacking + dual (4-quadrant x 2-LiDAR-regime = 8-stratum) Bayes prior calibration.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: +0.055 to +0.085 HOLDOUT-DTI over label-free physical baseline

ranked_hypotheses.title: Exact Linear-Fractional Dinkelbach-Minoux 300m Submodular Expected-DTI Allocator with Endogenous Marginal Break-Even Stopping
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Maximizes exact expected DW-Tversky DTI = E[TP_w] / (0.8 E[|G|] + 0.2 (E[TP_w] + E[FP_w])) over the 25 strictly positive cells of the 300m triangular kernel k(d) = max(1 - d/3, 0) via Dinkelbach fixed-point iteration and Minoux lazy-greedy priority queue, stopping endogenously when marginal expected coverage gain falls below the exact derivative threshold 0.2*lambda / (1 - 0.2*lambda) * (1 - q_E(x)).
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: Eliminates redundant within-cone dot crowding on wide range-front scarps so emission mass is reallocated to subtle blind intrabasin relays and geothermal wing-crack splays that clear the true metric break-even bar.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_fleet: Uses exact derivative break-even stopping (yielding an organic, non-arbitrary dot count rather than hard-coded 44,090 or 37,654) over our unique 8-stratum H86-FVMB posterior.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: +0.025 to +0.045 HOLDOUT-DTI over isotropic D2.8 Poisson-disk

ranked_hypotheses.title: Fluvial Steepness Knickzone & Cross-Divide Chi Disequilibrium Lineaments across Eroded Range-Interior Bedrock
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Active fault throw across incised bedrock ranges lacks alluvial scarps (LiDAR scarp = 0) but generates aligned high-ksn channel knickzones at intermediate drainage areas coupled with cross-divide elevation/chi asymmetry.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogue: Quaternary fault catalogues systematically under-map bedrock-hosted intrarange faults where erosion removes unconsolidated Quaternary fault scarps.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_fleet: Integrated directly as drainage-area-gated ksn knickzone x iSPI subsurface contact channels inside H86-1.
